cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives a figure from checking a register against the ID.
cells.note: Tax, TASAF social protection and business registration use the ID number (2026), and voter registration draws on the NIDA database (TZA-012); a November 2026 report that NIDA is still discussing TIN use for tax services (TZA-013) leaves three main registers either way. The 8.4 million tax numbers registered with ID numbers is a registration count, not a matching figure, so not stage 5.
